Moon Capital Management Boosted Leucadia Natl (LUK) Stake; MULLEN GROUP LD. ORDINARY SHARES CANADA (MLLGF) Shorts Increased By 12.75%
June 27, 2018 - By Adrian Erickson
Moon Capital Management Llc increased Leucadia Natl Corp (LUK) stake by 0.32% reported in 2018Q1 SEC filing. Moon Capital Management Llc acquired 558 shares as Leucadia Natl Corp (LUK)’s stock declined 4.13%. The Moon Capital Management Llc holds 176,590 shares with $4.01 billion value, up from 176,032 last quarter. Leucadia Natl Corp now has $8.09B valuation. The stock decreased 0.17% or $0.04 during the last trading session, reaching $23.47. About 1.82 million shares traded. Leucadia National Corporation (NYSE:LUK) has declined 5.32% since June 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 17.89% the S&P500. Mullen Group Ltd. provides transportation and related services to the oil and natural gas industry. The company has market cap of $1.17 billion. The companyÂ’s Oilfield Services segment offers specialized transportation, drilling, well-servicing, and dewatering services, which include the transporting of oversize and overweight shipments; and the transportation, handling, storage, and computerized inventory management of oilfield fluids, tubulars and drilling mud, pipe stockpiling, and stringing. It has a 30.12 P/E ratio. This segment provides services related to the processing and production of heavy oil, such as well servicing and handling, and transportation and disposal of fluids, as well as frac support, dredging, water management, dewatering, pond reclamation, hydrovac excavation, drilling rig relocation, and conductor pipe setting services.
